# Rights notice for files in this folder

**`POSOCO_data.csv` and `POSOCO_metadata.json`** are an unchanged research snapshot, retrieved on 29 October 2026, and **`latest_state_energy_GWh.csv`** is this project's extract of three state columns from it. The source is:

Andrew, R., *Indian Energy and Emissions Data*, https://robbieandrew.github.io/india/ — compiled from GRID-INDIA (formerly POSOCO) daily Power Supply Position reports.

No licence for this compilation was found. The author emailed the curator on 30 October 2026 to ask about reuse and redistribution; no reply had been received when this notice was written. The snapshot is kept so that published forecasts can be reproduced exactly, and it is attributed to its curator and the original reporting organisation. **Its presence here is not a claim of permission or a new licence.** It will be removed from the current version of the repository promptly if the curator asks.

The SASEA files (Coombes, Hunt & Bloomfield, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17175212) and `data/raw/` (Hunt & Bloomfield, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14983362) are CC BY 4.0, per their Zenodo records.
